verdict.rationale: LiveKit documents a dedicated data transport section. It covers RPC between participants, byte streams for arbitrary binary data with progress tracking, and data tracks for continuous low-latency data, and the server repo lists data tracks among its room transport features. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the data API's latency, and explicit documentation that data is synchronized with or carried alongside audio/video tracks in the same session.

support.subject: As a developer, participants exchange low-latency arbitrary data in the session alongside audio and video, with a documented data API

citations.quote: Stream continuous, low-latency data for robotics, IoT, and telemetry use cases.
Transfer files, images, or any binary data with progress tracking.
Execute custom methods on other participants and await a response.
